name: Big Hero 6 The Series
description: Picking up immediately following the events in the feature film, these are the continuing adventures and friendship of 14-year-old tech genius Hiro and his compassionate, cutting-edge robot Baymax. As the new prodigy at San Fransokyo Institute of Technology, Hiro now faces daunting academic challenges and the social trials of being the little man on campus. Off campus, the stakes are raised for the high-tech heroes as they must protect their city from an array of scientifically enhanced villains.

videos.title: Baymax and Fred
videos.overview: Fred is determined to create an alter ego for Baymax! Should Bayxmax’s alter ego be a cowboy? A fireman? A clown? A sumo wrestler? More importantly, will any of Fred’s ridiculous ideas stick?!

videos.title: Baymax and Go Go
videos.overview: Go Go attempts to teach Baymax how to roller-skate, but he can’t seem to slow down! Can she keep him from getting into trouble?!

videos.title: Baymax and Wasabi
videos.overview: Baymax wants to learn yoga poses, but he has a hard time mastering it! Can Wasabi teach him without getting too stressed out?!

videos.title: Baymax and Hiro
videos.overview: Hiro boosts Baymax's battery, which causes Baymax to go into overdrive! Oh no.

videos.title: Baymax and Mochi
videos.overview: While Aunt Cass is gone, Baymax tries to keep Mochi out of trouble, but he quickly learns that babysitting is harder than it looks!

videos.title: Baymax and Honey Lemon
videos.overview: Honey Lemon shows Baymax how to play tennis, but Baymax can't move quickly enough to hit the ball over the net! Can she figure out a way for him to play?

videos.title: Baymax Dreams of Too Many Baymaxes
videos.overview: Baymax's personality gets split into multiple versions of himself!

videos.title: Baymax Dreams of Evil Sheep
videos.overview: When Baymax counts too many sheep, a Junk Data Protocol begins deleting his new fluffy friends! Oh no.

videos.title: Baymax Dreams of Bed Bugs
videos.overview: As Hiro tries to remove Baymax's nasty computer virus, a swarm of bed bugs chase Baymax through his nightmare!

videos.title: Big Chibi 6: Making Popcorn
videos.overview: When Fred is out of popcorn for movie night, Go Go and the rest of the team help him plant corn and pop it in his backyard!

videos.title: Big Chibi 6: Mochi No!
videos.overview: Mochi causes chaos in the SFIT labs while Fred babysits!

videos.title: Big Chibi 6: Save Mochi
videos.overview: Mochi gets stuck in a tree and Big Hero 6 has to help him down!

videos.title: Big Chibi 6: Noodle Song
videos.overview: Jam out to Noodle Burger Boy's full length jingle featuring Big Hero 6 as the band!

videos.title: Big Chibi 6: Snoring
videos.overview: When Honey Lemon's snoring prevents Go Go from sleeping, Go Go  enlists the rest of the team to help her fix the problem!

videos.title: Big Chibi 6: Gumball Trouble
videos.overview: Go Go mistakes Honey Lemon's mini chem-balls for gumballs!

videos.title: Big Chibi 6: Love Letters
videos.overview: Karmi is determined to give Captain Cutie a love letter, but he’s just as determined not to accept it!

videos.title: Big Chibi 6: Super Charged
videos.overview: Noodle Burger Boy prepares to charge for his ultra secret move so our heroes decide to also charge up!

videos.title: Big Chibi 6: Low Battery
videos.overview: A low-battery Baymax refuses to get into his charger!

videos.title: Big Chibi 6: Road Trip
videos.overview: On a long road trip, Big Hero 6 team has some interesting dreams!

videos.title: Big Chibi 6: Super Driver
videos.overview: Wasabi needs a little extra cash and signs up to be a super driver, but his clients end up being some of San Fransokyo’s most wanted!

videos.title: Big Chibi 6: Brunch Rush
videos.overview: Aunt Cass is away at a café conference and leaves Hiro and his friends in charge of the Lucky Cat. However, they soon find themselves serving some familiar looking super villains!

videos.title: Baymax & Mochi: Flowers and Butterflies
videos.overview: A mischievous Mochi keeps pushing plants out the window for Baymax to catch! To Baymax's delight, the flowers attract a swarm of butterflies!

videos.title: Baymax & Mochi: Mochi and his Toy
videos.overview: Baymax tries to help Mochi retrieve his favorite toy!

videos.title: Baymax & Mochi: Messy Room
videos.overview: Oh no! Hiro's room is an absolute mess! Baymax and Mochi work together as a team to make it spotless!

videos.title: Baymax Dreams of Mochizilla
videos.overview: Fred accidentally overloads Baymax's core processor and causes the monster Mochizilla to attack!

videos.title: Baymax Dreams of Too Many Freds
videos.overview: Fred gets identified as a corrupt file and is split into a million pieces! It's up to Baymax and all the tiny Freds to put him back together!

videos.title: Baymax Dreams of Fred's Glitch
videos.overview: Dropping Fred into Baymax's virtual mind...? Of course a glitch during the upload process causes some hiccups, one of which is named Gertrude.

videos.title: Baymax Returns
videos.overview: Hiro thinks Baymax is lost forever, until he finds the chip that Tadashi designed to create Baymax. Hiro immediately gets to work rebuilding his friend.

videos.title: Issue 188
videos.overview: As Hiro tries to find a way to connect to classmate Karmi, Go Go and Fred dive deep into comic book mythology to defeat High Voltage, a mother-daughter supervillain duo.

videos.title: Big Roommates 2
videos.overview: Go Go and Honey Lemon quickly clash when they become roommates. Meanwhile, when a thief steals Honey Lemon’s chem-lab purse, it accidentally turns him into a monster.

videos.title: Fred's Bro-Tillion
videos.overview: When supervillain Baron Von Steamer crashes Fred’s Bro-Tillion, the Big Hero 6 team springs into action.

videos.title: Food Fight
videos.overview: When Aunt Cass stumbles into an underground cooking competition, she thrives and becomes addicted to the excitement.

videos.title: Muirahara Woods
videos.overview: Hiro, Fred, and Baymax follow GoGo into the mysterious Muirahara Woods where they get lost and everything electronic strangely fails including Baymax.

videos.title: Failure Mode
videos.overview: Hiro becomes demoralized when his latest school project fails spectacularly; the team must take on the incompetent villain, Globby.

videos.title: Aunt Cass Goes Out
videos.overview: After Aunt Cass nearly discovers Hiro's secret membership in the Big Hero 6, Hiro tries to set her up with someone to distract her.

videos.title: The Impatient Patient
videos.overview: Although he is obviously ill, Hiro refuses to listen to his team-mates and Baymax and only watch from afar as they fight the mercenary team Mad Jacks.

videos.title: Mr. Sparkles Loses His Sparkle
videos.overview: Crazy game show host Mr. Sparkles threatens to hurt Hiro's cat Mochi to force Go Go to join a game. But she is very afraid of public appearances.

videos.title: Killer App
videos.overview: Wasabi's need for order clashes with Hiro's chaotic work style when they collaborate on a school project.

videos.title: Small Hiro One
videos.overview: Hiro becomes frustrated when he's deemed too young to attend a science workshop hosted by SFIT's most famous alumni, Dr. Trevor Trengrove.

videos.title: Kentucky Kaiju
videos.overview: Hiro decides to upgrade himself with super strength.

videos.title: Rivalry Weak
videos.overview: Honey Lemon takes art classes at a rival school.

videos.title: Fan Friction
videos.overview: Karmi posts Big Hero 6 fan fiction, embarrassing Hiro.

videos.title: Mini-Max
videos.overview: Hiro invents a tiny robot, Mini-Max, to supervise and be a sidekick to Fred while the rest of the team is in class.

videos.title: Big Hero 7
videos.overview: Richardson Mole blackmails his way into Big Hero 6.

videos.title: Big Problem
videos.overview: When a monster wreaks havoc in San Fransokyo, Big Hero 6 must go on a real-life monster hunt.

videos.title: Steamer's Revenge
videos.overview: Hiro and the others plan the ultimate birthday surprise for Wasabi by recovering his car from the bottom of the bay, but Baron Von Steamer ruins the celebration.

videos.title: The Bot-Fighter
videos.overview: To try to prove Yama is behind a mysterious crime spree, perpetrated by tiny bots, Hiro is drawn back into the illegal world of bot-fighting.

videos.title: Obake Yashiki
videos.overview: After the gang goes to a spooky haunted house, Hiro keeps seeing Tadashi around the city and ultimately finds himself face to face with his brother.

videos.title: Countdown to Catastrophe
videos.overview: Big Hero 6 face their greatest challenge as Obake unleashes his plan on San Fransokyo.

videos.title: Internabout
videos.overview: Hiro’s jealousy of Karmi’s internship at Sycorax leads him to intern at Krei Tech.

videos.title: Seventh Wheel
videos.overview: Professor Granville becomes increasingly pushy with Big Hero 6 as she helps them figure out a mysterious series of food-related burglaries.

videos.title: Prey Date
videos.overview: Hiro and Fred enlist Karmi to find out what happened to Orso Knox, the man who was mysteriously turned into a monster.

videos.title: Something's Fishy
videos.overview: When Aunt Cass sets Hiro up on a date, he begins to wonder if he’s missing out on being a regular kid.

videos.title: Nega-Globby
videos.overview: Honey Lemon sets out to make Globby human again.

videos.title: The Fate of the Roommates
videos.overview: Big Hero 6 must stop a secret underground racing league.

videos.title: Muira-Horror!
videos.overview: When Hiro and Go Go accompany Krei to the woods to deal with Nedd Ludd, they run into The Hibagon, a legendary monster.

videos.title: Something Fluffy
videos.overview: Mayoi, mysterious yet adorable creatures, begin to appear in San Fransokyo.

videos.title: Supersonic Sue
videos.overview: Big Hero 6 attempts to thwart a bank robbery and encounter Supersonic Sue, an old school roller skating villain.

videos.title: Lie Detector
videos.overview: Upon discovering Baymax’s ability to detect if a person is lying, Hiro attempts to use him to uncover proof of deceit.

videos.title: Write Turn Here
videos.overview: Karmi and Hiro team up to help treat someone with genetically engineered parasites.

videos.title: City of Monsters (1)
videos.overview: Karmi and Hiro team up to help treat someone with genetically engineered parasites.

videos.title: City of Monsters (2)
videos.overview: Big Hero 6 must continue to fight off a city overrun with monsters.

videos.title: Mini-Maximum Trouble
videos.overview: When Fred runs into a string of bad luck, Megan reveals to Hiro that she’s trying to uncover the true identities of Big Hero 6 for her school’s newspaper.

videos.title: El Fuego
videos.overview: Professional mech-wrestler El Fuego is intent on becoming the toughest fighter in San Fransokyo and decides he must beat the strongest challenger he can find, Baymax.

videos.title: The Globby Within
videos.overview: Nega-Globby takes control of Globby’s body to cause chaos around the city.

videos.title: Hardlight
videos.overview: Evil villain Hardlight challenges the Big Hero 6 team to a real-life video game duel.

videos.title: The Present
videos.overview: When Hiro finds a wrapped present in the closet, he assumes it's from Aunt Cass and takes it in order to figure out what it is. However, after a mix-up, the present becomes lost and Hiro enlists the Big Hero 6 team to track it down.

videos.title: Hiro The Villain
videos.overview: Momakase blackmails Hiro into helping her steal her family's knives from Yama's safe.

videos.title: Portal Enemy
videos.overview: Megan confronts Hiro about being a vigilante and threatens to tell Chief Cruz the truth.

videos.title: Fred the Fugitive
videos.overview: Fred's invisibility function on his suit glitches during patrol.

videos.title: Major Blast
videos.overview: A new villain, Major Blast, appears in the city and targets Fred.

videos.title: Fear Not
videos.overview: Supersonic Stu busts his grandmother, Supersonic Sue, out of prison.

videos.title: Legacies
videos.overview: Chief Cruz and the police get the upper hand in their battle with both villains and Big Hero 6 when they begin using Buddy Guardians, powerful new robots produced by Krei Tech.

videos.title: The Hyper-potamus Pizza-Party-torium
videos.overview: Hiro and a short-handed Big Hero 6 team attempt to stop Noodle Burger Boy and his new family.

videos.title: Mayor for a Day
videos.overview: Big Hero 6 responds to Richardson Mole’s every whim when he is made mayor for the day.

videos.title: The Dog Craze of Summer
videos.overview: Hiro enlists the help of the team when Granville’s three dogs go missing while under his watch.

videos.title: Trading Chips
videos.overview: Hiro switches Baymax’s chip with Mini-Max’s so that Baymax can rescue Mochi.

videos.title: Mini Noodle Burger Max
videos.overview: A low-charged Baymax and Mini-Max join forces with Noodle Burger Boy to save Big Hero 6.

videos.title: A Friendly Face
videos.overview: When Krei wants to sell the Mayor an automated fleet of shuttle vehicles, Honey Lemon suggests giving the shuttles a friendly face and an upbeat personality.

videos.title: Big Chibi 6
videos.overview: Hardlight crashes Karmi’s autograph session.

videos.title: Cobra and Mongoose
videos.overview: After Fred is attacked by mechanical cobras, he learns that they were actually sent after Heathcliff.

videos.title: Better Off Fred
videos.overview: Fred meets the girl of his dreams, Olivia, only to be rejected by her for reasons he doesn’t understand.

videos.title: Big Hero Battle
videos.overview: 4 2 Sing, a famous boy band, decides to be crime fighters and challenge Big Hero 6 to a superhero-off.

videos.title: Go Go the Wooweroo
videos.overview: Go Go reluctantly goes undercover as the co-host of Wendy Wower's television show.

videos.title: The New Nega-Globby
videos.overview: Globby and Honey Lemon feel guilty about trapping Nega-Globby in the Glop-Vac.

videos.title: De-Based
videos.overview: When Basemax opens a spam email, she gets infected with a virus.

videos.title: The MiSFIT
videos.overview: In order to recruit child prodigy Rishi Patel, Professor Granville enlists Hiro to give him a tour of SFIT.

videos.title: Return to Sycorax
videos.overview: When Krei is lost in the old Sycorax building, the heroes must search the abandoned monster factory to find him.

videos.title: A Fresh Sparkles
videos.overview: When Big Hero 6 find Mr. Sparkles working at the Pizza Party-torium, he tells them he's decided to leave the world of crime behind.

videos.title: Noodle Burger Ploy
videos.overview: Noodle Burger Boy and the mascots abduct Fred.

videos.title: Krei-oke Night
videos.overview: Krei invents a karaoke machine.

videos.title: The Mascot Upshot
videos.overview: Hiro plans to defeat The Mascots once and for all.

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 1 win & 6 nominations total
